dedupe_keys.name: списък на общинските пътища в област благоевград

description: Списък на общинските пътища в област Благоевград is a dataset listed in Open Data Bulgaria, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Васил Рашков. List of municipal roads in Blagoevgrad district, amended and supplemented by Council of Ministers Decisions No 155/2009, Nos 301 and 677/2011, 807, 871 and 1016/2012, 340 and 646/2014, 110, 852 and 1031/2015 and 148/2016. Coverage: Васил Рашков. The portal shows the English title as "List of municipal roads in Blagoevgrad district" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Васил Рашков. Its keywords include област, път, регистър, общински пътища, Благоевград, РМС 567/2021. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-bulgaria.
